stem:
Write the names of shapes A, B, and C in the spaces provided.

[Image: a school bus is shown with three arrows pointing to three different shapes]

A. ____

B. ____

C. ____

descriptors: A: Triangle  B: Rectangle or oblong or more general correct terms such as parallelogram, quadrilateral or tetragon  C: Circle (allow cylinder for circle)
Other incorrect (including crossed out, erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description:
A side-view illustration of a bus facing left. Along the side of the bus is a horizontal row of identical vertically oriented rectangular windows, two circular wheels, and a solid black right-pointing triangle on the side of the bus body. Three arrows point from the answer blank areas to three features of the bus:
- An arrow originating above blank A points up and to the right to the black triangle.
- An arrow originating above blank B points straight up to one of the rectangular windows.
- An arrow originating above blank C points up and to the left to the circular rear wheel.
